query: What are the top creative and high-quality trends in Business, Economics, and Management based on our discussion of integrated frameworks, regulatory overlays, pilot protocols, operational components, and data governance?

response.query: What are the top creative and high-quality trends in Business, Economics, and Management based on our discussion of integrated frameworks, regulatory overlays, pilot protocols, operational components, and data governance?
response.answer: Collaborative AI frameworks, regulatory sandboxes, and advanced data governance are top trends in business, economics, and management. These trends focus on innovation, compliance, and ethical AI use.

results.title: AI in regulatory design and delivery: Governing with ...
results.content: To achieve this, governments need to move away from the traditional “regulate-and-forget” approach of regulatory policymaking and adopt an “adapt-and-learn” approach [(OECD, 2024[24])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_d909ff7a_6f09aca72d).1 Digital technologies, including AI, play a pivotal role in this shift, not only by extending the regulatory toolbox but also by enabling more innovative, effective and efficient rule making through data-driven design, decision-making and enforcement [(OECD, 2021[25])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_8f99ec8c_6f09aca72d). OECD [(OECD, 2025[31];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kapp_56b60e39_6f09aca72d) [2020[36])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_db481aa3_6f09aca72d) analysis shows that digital tools help regulators by enabling better data use and informed decision-making. Recent ML applications are promising in identifying key risk predictors, considerably improving the effectiveness of risk-based targeting [(OECD, 2021[28])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_38b0fdb1_6f09aca72d). Improving inspection efficiency and regulatory enforcement depends on a precise understanding of risks to the public interest [(OECD, 2014[41])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_g2g3b1b4_6f09aca72d). Regulatory authorities could therefore use social media platforms and ML techniques to support risk analysis and gain broader and timelier insights than through traditional methods [(OECD, 2021[28])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/ai-in-justice-administration-and-access-to-justice_f0cbe651.html#Kappa_38b0fdb1_6f09aca72d).
